column1: # phrases.tsv — the phrase table: whole phrases with their meaning and when to use them.
# Shown in the app's Meanings panel (direction "Phrases"): search by English meaning,
# by the typed roman key, or by category ("festival", "greeting", "you"...), then Insert
# or Copy the Odia. It does not change typing suggestions or word ranking.
# Format: roman <TAB> odia <TAB> category <TAB> meaning <TAB> status <TAB> note
#   roman     how people type it, lower case; more than one spelling separated by |
#             (the first is the careful spelling that the engine turns into this Odia)
#   odia      the phrase in Odia script; canonical (nukta decomposed: U+0B21 U+0B3C)
#   category  greeting | wish | festival | you | family | everyday
#   status    owner = written or checked by the owner; seed = suggested by an agent,
#             shown with "awaiting native-speaker review" until the owner checks it
#   note      optional: when or to whom it is said (register, season, region)
# Owner: change seed to owner when a row is right; fix or delete it when it is wrong;
# add your own rows (send them in chat if you prefer). Licence: MIT (this project).
